name: amda-skill
description: Frameworks for enterprise AI go-to-market, packaged as installable agent skills. Decision governance and pilot production-readiness.

plugins.name: amda-decision-router
plugins.description: Three skills. amda-decision-router sorts marketing and GTM decisions into three AI governance zones by reversibility, exposure and frequency. pilot-trap-auditor places an enterprise AI pilot on a five-stage arc and names which of six infrastructure gaps are open. trust-architecture-diagnostic finds which of three sequential trust layers is blocking a deal. All three ship with labelled evaluation cases.
